correctness.rationale: The operator F is symmetric over F2; its single-site Krylov span is generated by the center and reflected pairs. For even n, antipodal walks cancel in pairs. A configuration is invisible iff it is reflection invariant and zero at every sensor. Products of reflections translate by twice offset differences; quotient size h=gcd(n,2g) and negation-orbit counts give precisely floor(g/2) when n/g is odd and g−1 otherwise. Mobius inversion counts g=1 sets. Two sensors yield no full rank with fewer than ceil(n/2) frames by equation counting. Independent GF2 ranks and census agree in all 2032 n3..10 nonempty layouts and 52 census cells.
